description: This file contains Python code demonstrating run-length encoding and decoding, along with tests using the Hypothesis property-based testing library. It includes functions for encoding and decoding sequences, and tests to verify the correctness and properties of these functions.

methods.name: run_length_encode
methods.description: Encodes a sequence into run-length encoded form, representing consecutive identical elements as [element, count].

methods.name: run_length_decode
methods.description: Decodes a run-length encoded sequence back into the original sequence.

methods.name: test_decodes_to_starting_sequence
methods.description: Test that encoding then decoding a sequence returns the original sequence.

methods.name: test_duplicating_an_element_does_not_increase_length
methods.description: Test that duplicating an element within a sequence does not increase the length of its run-length encoding.
